name: ametller-origen
description: Shop at Ametller Origen from Claude — search the catalog, fill and review the real cart, reorder past shops, and show products as photo grids. You sign in in a browser and pay on the Ametller Origen site.
long_description:
Shop your Ametller Origen online groceries by talking to Claude. The extension drives your own authenticated Ametller Origen session: it browses the catalog, reads your purchase history, and adds, changes, or removes items in your real cart so you and Claude can fill it together.

**Key Features:**
• **Search and browse** the catalog (Catalan works best), with prices in euros.
• **Fill the real cart** — add items, set quantities, or remove them; every change is reversible.
• **Reorder a past shop** in one step with "buy again."
• **Photo grids** — products are shown as an HTML artifact with photo, name, price, and link.

**You stay in control of payment.** There is no checkout or payment tool, by design — Claude fills the cart and you review and pay on the Ametller Origen site, where Strong Customer Authentication happens. Sign in once through a browser window (handling any 2FA); the session is stored locally on your machine and never leaves it.

This extension targets Claude Desktop. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Ametller Origen.

tools.name: ametller_get_shopping_guide
tools.description: Return the Ametller Origen shopping playbook (how to present products, fill the cart, reorder). Read first, at the start of any Ametller task.

tools.name: ametller_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the Ametller Origen session is valid.

tools.name: ametller_login
tools.description: Open a browser window to sign in to Ametller Origen (handling any 2FA); the session is saved so the other tools work.

tools.name: ametller_search_products
tools.description: Find products and their ids; an id is needed before adding to the cart.

tools.name: ametller_get_product
tools.description: Get details for a single product by id.

tools.name: ametller_get_cart
tools.description: Show the current real cart: items, quantities, and total.

tools.name: ametller_get_purchase_history
tools.description: List past orders with date, total, status, and item count.

tools.name: ametller_get_order_items
tools.description: List the products in a past order without adding anything (defaults to the latest order).

tools.name: ametller_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the real cart by id (increments the quantity if it is already present).

tools.name: ametller_set_quantity
tools.description: Set the exact quantity of a product in the cart (0 removes it).

tools.name: ametller_remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart entirely.

tools.name: ametller_reorder_order
tools.description: Add all items from a past order to the cart in one step (a 'buy again'); defaults to the latest order.
